Audience: first-time Hawaii class three applicants, including minors on the graduated path, learning driver licensing exemptions, identity and legal presence rules, license types, preliminary examinations and the graduated path for minors in plain English.

Prerequisites: none beyond reading English; this is the first chapter a new applicant meets and it defines the permit, provisional and class three steps the rest of the manual assumes.

Scope note: exemptions from licensing, who cannot be licensed, REAL ID identity and residence proofs, the limited purpose license, license types and classes, the preliminary examinations, what the license card shows, and the graduated licensing conditions for minors. License categories, the road test itself, renewal and citations follow in the next section.

Recall emphasis: ages, holding periods, supervision conditions and document counts are practiced as recall items; no scenario or recognition surface is needed for this section.
